vb_textbox.text: For the first couple of tries, pick alternative Gnomes from the pairs, so brown then purple, and green then pink so you can determine which Gnome is the best. Stick with the same Gnome until they start to pick low numbers of mushrooms, generally 3 or below, then switch to the other Gnome in that pair. To make it quicker, keep your fingers over the S & K keys and another hovering over the space bar to collect the mushrooms.
